comments.author: aura-32
comments.body:
A few that saved me a lot of pain:

- Ask for one system at a time (movement, then combat, then camera), and playtest between each.
- When something breaks, paste the actual error and what you expected. Don't just say "it's broken."
- Commit to git before every big change, so you can roll back when it goes sideways.
- Have it write a short notes file describing how your systems connect, and keep it updated.

Looks fun so far, the DMC influence is a cool mix with Zelda.
